ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a light-yellow shaded triangle. Its bottom horizontal side is the line segment on the lower right labeled 5 in. On the left there is a pink dashed vertical line segment labeled 8 in., and it forms a right angle with the pink dashed horizontal line; this horizontal dashed line is on the same line as the triangle's base or its extension, so 8 in. is the height corresponding to the 5 in. base. The figure also marks 15 in. and 21.5 in., but according to the required area formula they do not need to be used. Reasoning: The triangle area formula is A = (1/2)bh. Take base b = 5 and height h = 8, then A = (1/2)(5)(8) = 20. Therefore the area of the triangle is 20 square inches.

method.method_draft: Read the shaded triangle in the image: its horizontal bottom side is the segment labeled 5 in., and the dashed vertical 8 in. segment is perpendicular to the same baseline/extended baseline, so it is the altitude to that 5 in. base. From the text, the required quantity is the triangle's area. Apply the triangle area formula A = (1/2)bh using b = 5 and h = 8 to get A = (1/2)(5)(8) = 20.

推理：三角形面积公式为 A = (1/2)bh。取底 b = 5，高 h = 8，则 A = (1/2)(5)(8) = 20。因此三角形面积是 20 平方英寸。

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a large right triangle minus a smaller right triangle. The dashed height is 8 in. The full horizontal distance from the left dashed vertical to the right endpoint is 15 in. + 5 in. = 20 in., forming a large right triangle with area (1/2)(20)(8) = 80. The unshaded left right triangle has base 15 in. and height 8 in., so its area is (1/2)(15)(8) = 60. Subtract the unshaded triangle from the large triangle to get the shaded triangle's area: 80 - 60 = 20.
